title: skills(objectstack-query): SKILL.md:66 teaches `{ flowRunId }` as a context "for provenance alone", which the engine refuses since ADR-0096 D5
body:
Filing gate: **① a governed-text defect (Tier H), class (a), published surface.** reach: `skills/objectstack-query/SKILL.md` ships as a published agent skill. An AI author following line 66 writes an execution context the engine refuses.

Filed by `domain:spec` seat 2 (seat post #18549), `session_01DhTqaEHqPVSVnAkjG3jywn`. This is the Tier H carrier that seat's ACCEPT on PR #22327 (`6067117343`, #22302) owed. The `domain:services` seat 1's note `6070292301` (on #18549) adds a second reason and leaves this card as the one carrier. ⛔ Not graded or routed here; ⛔ not a claim.

## What is false

`skills/objectstack-query/SKILL.md:66` (on `main` at `b46015391`):

> Pass any SUBSET of the execution envelope (identity, tenant, transaction): `{ isSystem: true }` for a system read, `{ flowRunId }` for provenance alone.

- **Since ADR-0096 D5** (PR #22297), `plugin-security` refuses a context that carries no principal and is not a system context, at all six sites. The engine middleware answers `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`; the read filter is the deny filter; `canReadObject` / `canWriteObject` / `canExport` answer `false`. So `{ flowRunId }` alone, which the line prescribes, is refused.
- PR #22327 (#22302, held behind #22014) corrects the same sentence in `ISecurityService`'s TSDoc and `content/docs/kernel/contracts/data-engine.mdx`. The skill is governed, so that PR does not edit it.
- **Second reason:** PR #22357 (#22345, the services seat, in the merge queue) retires the `RunProvenanceContext` type from `@objectstack/service-automation`. The context shape this line describes no longer has a type behind it (that PR's contract review, `6070198297`).

## The fix

A one-line in-place edit of `SKILL.md:66`. It drops "`{ flowRunId }` for provenance alone", or replaces it with the shape the engine admits: a principal-carrying context, or `{ isSystem: true }`. Follow PR #22327's wording once that lands, so the skill and the contract say one thing. Also measure whether the skill's evals or examples assert the old line.

Tier H: `skills/**` is governed, so the PR is the maintainer's to merge. `dispatch-gates --tier` on this path names the contract-review tier as MANDATORY.

Dedupe words: `objectstack-query flowRunId provenance alone` · `SKILL.md principal-less context` · `ADR-0096 D5 skill`
